messages:
Sam (CSM): Kicking off Nimbus Analytics onboarding. Objective: launch a pilot inference endpoint for support summarization in 30 days and deliver a renewal recommendation pack. Need to align stakeholders, success criteria, timeline, and quick feedback loop.
Priya (Solutions Eng): I can own integration and perf baselines. Question: do they want Dedicated or Private?
Kai (Nimbus Eng): We need VPC for data controls; prefer Dedicated for pilot but can start hosted for dev. Legal also asks for embedding retention off by default.
Jules (Onboarding PM): Suggested 5-week timeline: Week 0: access + infra + kickoff; Week 1: API integration + smoke perf; Week 2: prompt tuning + evals; Week 3: internal beta w/ 6 users; Week 4: external pilot + feedback; Week 5: go/no-go + renewal recommendation.
Sam (CSM): Success criteria: 1) p95 latency < 300ms for key prompts; 2) median cost <= target agreed with finance; 3) 3 automated workflows live; 4) pilot satisfaction >= 7/10; 5) security sign-off for VPC & retention. I'll own the checklist.
onboard-bot: Onboarding workspace created: https://redwood.internal/onboard/Nimbus-901 (restricted)
Priya (Solutions Eng): Action items: post sample prompt bank and a smoke-test curl by tomorrow EOD; include a quantized fallback for cost SLOs.
Kai (Nimbus Eng): Okta metadata will be sent today. We'll nominate 6 power users for the beta. Risk: legal sign-off on retention could add 3 business days.
Jules (Onboarding PM): I'll publish a one-page risk register (SSO delay, legal, networking) and update it every 48h. Training proposed Thurs 11am PT — confirm.
Sam (CSM): Thurs 11am PT works. Owners recap: Priya -> integration & perf; Jules -> timeline & risk register; Sam -> success metrics & survey; Kai -> infra, Okta, user roster. If blockers, @mention this thread. :thumbsup:
_meta: format: slack thread; messages are chronological; single continuous 'messages' string contains root and replies
